question: The Lucknow Pact of 1916 provided a joint political platform for the moderates, radicals of the Indian national Congress and the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muslim League.**__

__
 
• The Lucknow Pact is an agreement between the INC and the All India Muslim League.
 
• The Lucknow Pact was an agreement reached between the Indian National Congress and the Muslim League (AIMLM) at a joint session of both the parties held in Lucknow in December 1916.__
